nuggets.text: The Lobos' 38-7 rout of Central Michigan was their first season-opening win over an FBS team since 2005.
The Lobos' 38 points were their most in an opener against an FBS team since a 61-21 win over New Mexico State in 1984.
The Lobos held Central Michigan to 30 passing yards, the fewest they have allowed a non-option team since 2007.
The Lobos have won eight straight home games, a streak dating back to November 16, 2024.
Saturday's game is the first Lobos football game ever broadcast exclusively on MW+, the Mountain West's streaming service.
Jason Eck was Mountain West Coach of the Year last season, and his son, linebacker Jaxton Eck, shared Defensive Player of the Year.
Jaxton Eck followed his father from Idaho to New Mexico and made a team-high 129 tackles for the Lobos last season.
Lobos coach Jason Eck played college football as a walk-on offensive lineman at Wisconsin.
The Lobos beat UCLA 35-10 in the Rose Bowl last season, their first win ever over a Big Ten team.
The Lobos' University Stadium was built in an arroyo, its stands set on embankments piled from the excavated dirt.
